# Run index (generated by src/90_make_runs_index.py; do not edit by hand)

Environment: see `environment.txt`. Server layout: `~/era_market` with `src/` (these scripts), `venv*` (python environments per tool family), `results/` (json outputs, copied into `results/` of this repo except `.npz` embeddings), `gen_*` directories (generated audio, not in the repo).

## Scripts

| script | what it does (first line of its header) | usage |
|---|---|---|
| `01_separate.py` | HT Demucs separation of every PA1 clip into vocals and accompaniment (drums+bass+other). | python 01_separate.py --ds A [--limit N] |
| `02_embed.py` | MERT-v2-30s (m-a-p/MERT-v2-30s) mean-pooled hidden states per layer for each condition. | python 02_embed.py --ds A --conds mix_raw mix_norm ... |
| `02b_embed_muq.py` | MuQ-large-msd-iter mean-pooled hidden states per layer, same conditions as 02_embed.py.  saves emb/<ds>_muq_<cond>.npy (N, L, 1024) fp16. |  |
| `03_stats.py` | Signal-statistics features per clip (shortcut baseline): integrated loudness, short-term loudness range, crest factor, RMS, | python 03_stats.py --ds A |
| `04_probe.py` | Frozen-embedding probes per condition. Layer and C chosen by 5-fold CV on the train split only, scored once on validation. | python 04_probe.py --ds A --emb ~/era_market/emb --out results/probe_A.json [--conds ...] |
| `05_langid.py` | Whisper language-ID posterior (99 languages) for the vocal stem (norm) and the mix.  saves emb/<ds>_lid_<voc/mix>.npy (N, 99) and lang list. | python 05_langid.py --ds B |
| `06_extra_probes.py` | Shortcut baselines and nested comparisons, same protocol as 04 (CV on train picks C, scored once on validation). | python 06_extra_probes.py --ds B --emb ~/era_market/emb --probe results/probe_B.json --out results/extra_B.json |

| `08_bleed.py` | Vocal-bleed diagnostics: per-clip vocal share of energy (rms_voc / (rms_voc + rms_acc)) and the Whisper-small language posterior of the ACCOMPANIMENT stem. | python 08_bleed.py --ds B |
| `09_bleed_analysis.py` | Mac-side analysis of vocal-bleed diagnostics. usage: python 09_bleed_analysis.py <manifest_dir>  (manifest_A.csv, manifest_B.csv with split/label columns; not committed) | python 09_bleed_analysis.py <manifest_dir>  (manifest_A.csv, manifest_B.csv with split/label columns; not committed) |
